question: Who among the following fought the Mughal emperor Babur in 1527 at Khanwa?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rana Sanga**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Rana Sanga, also known as Maharana Sangram Singh, was the ruler of Mewar in Rajasthan.
 
• He fought the Battle of Khanwa against the Mughal emperor Babur on March 16, 1527.
 
• The battle was significant as it marked the establishment of Mughal rule in India after defeating the Rajput confederacy.
 
• Rana Sanga's forces were ultimately defeated by Babur's well-organized and strategically superior army.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mewar Kingdom**: The kingdom of Mewar was one of the most powerful Rajput states in medieval India, known for its valiant warriors and resistance against foreign invasions.
 
• **Babur's Strategy**: Babur used advanced artillery and tactics such as the Tulughma (dividing the army into smaller units) and Araba (using carts for defense) to defeat Rana Sanga.
 
• **Rajput Confederacy**: Rana Sanga led a confederacy of Rajput states and other allies against Babur, demonstrating a united front against the Mughal invasion.
 
• **Aftermath of the Battle**: The defeat at Khanwa weakened the Rajput resistance and paved the way for the Mughal Empire to consolidate its power in northern India.
